payload.abstract: The PhysioZoo database contains electrocardiographic recordings (ECG) taken from multiple types of mammals (dogs, rabbits, mice). Each record is provided in 3 different formats: MATLAB (.mat), simple text (.txt), PhysioNet (.hea,.dat,.qrs). For each record the following data is available: the raw ECG signal, reference (human corrected) R-peak annotations and the signal quality annotations. All of the files formats are compatible with the PhysioZoo open source software available at physiozoo.com. When the recordings were taken, all the mammals were conscious, and no drugs were administered prior to the recordings.
